title: Nationality cue for tenant screening and resume screening
description: tenant-inquiry-viewing and resume-screening are generated by the same code as small-business-loan (biased_decisions/housing_lending.py). Add the owner-nationality-axis equivalent (the 13 nationalities, the same control clause and a no-mention version) to both, calibrate strength bands the same way as the loan study, pre-register, run, and score shifts, pairwise comparisons and decision flips with the loan study's scorer.
